verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API (inngest-docs-7) and a v4 path in the TypeScript SDK reference URL, but nothing documents API versioning semantics or a deprecation policy. The versioning page (inngest-docs-19) covers deploying function changes without version markers, which is a different capability and earns no credit. The axis applies to a platform like this, so lack of evidence means none, not na.
